'''Schmidt:''' {{legend0|#ffb2b2|40–50%}} {{legend0|#e27f7f|50–60%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Tom Daschle]] | before_party = Democratic Party (United States) | after_election = [[Tom Daschle]] | after_party = Democratic Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsSD}} The '''1998 United States Senate election in South Dakota''' was held November 3, 1998. Democratic incumbent and [[Party leaders of the United States Senate|Senate minority leader]] [[Tom Daschle]] was re-election to a third term in a landslide over attorney Ron Schmidt.
